definitions: To re-engage with an activity or interest after a period of not doing it.
To return to a previous state or condition, often a positive one.
To put on a piece of clothing again, especially after it was too small or you had stopped wearing it.
examples: I need to get back into running after my injury.
It took a while to get back into the swing of things at work.
She was delighted to get back into her old jeans.
He's trying to get back into a healthy routine.
pastTenses: got back into (simple), got back into (perfect)
